description: This file defines data structures and functions for collecting and calculating CPU, memory, load average, and uptime statistics from Linux /proc filesystem.

classes.name: CPUSample
classes.description: Represents CPU time breakdown in various modes, taken from /proc/stat.

classes.name: ProcCPUAverage
classes.description: Represents average CPU usage of a process over time.

classes.name: SimpleCPUAverage
classes.description: Represents simplified CPU usage over a period, focusing on idle and busy percentages.

classes.name: CPUAverage
classes.description: Represents detailed CPU usage percentages over a time interval.

methods.name: GetCPUAverage
methods.description: Calculates average CPU usage between two CPUSamples.

methods.name: GetSimpleCPUAverage
methods.description: Calculates simplified CPU usage between two CPUSamples.

methods.name: GetProcCPUAverage
methods.description: Calculates CPU usage of a process between two samples.

methods.name: GetCPUSample
methods.description: Takes a snapshot of CPU stats from /proc/stat.

methods.name: GetProcCPUSample
methods.description: Takes a snapshot of process CPU stats.
